claim_boundary: Static nomenclature audit. No hardware measurement. Recommend only; no source under hcli/, tools/, or crates/ was modified.
law: Model identity is DATA (model_id, nx_id, architecture, revision, profile). Generic architectural roles are resident / resident_incumbent / resident_candidate / resident_child / resident_shadow. Historical receipts and sealed artifacts stay historical. Canonical FUTURE-FACING APIs may become generic via aliases. Do not mass-rename.

prior_census.census_already_said: There is no safe retroactive rename of a catalogued name. Forward-only new identifiers and alias tables; not git mv. Ascension owned_paths 4028 files / 1.82 GiB; Genesis 78 files; QwenPatients 4304 files / hawking.qwen38. and hawking.q80. schema prefixes.
prior_census.this_audit_adds: The live running body still carries a vestigial campaign name plus a patient name in the process/binary that occupies the generic resident role. The 2026-08-27 census classified Ascension as VESTIGIAL; it did not call out that the current resident argv0 is still ascension_qwen38_resident.

live_body_observed.note: Two PIDs matched the same argv at audit time. WAVE_STATE already answered the process/memory audit; this lane does not re-litigate duplicate load. The nomenclature fact is the argv0, not the PID count.

resident_candidate.note: hcli/agentos/checkpoint.py local variable resident_candidates is a path list, not the canonical role token
